definitions.gloss: birds and beasts; wildlife; wild birds and mammals
definitions.explanation: A collective term for wild birds and mammals. Used in literary, legal, and environmental contexts to refer to wildlife in general.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鳥獣|ちょうじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生息|せいそく}→生息：13542_seisoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many birds and beasts inhabit this forest.

examples.japanese: {鳥獣|ちょうじゅう}{保護法|ほごほう}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{狩猟|しゅりょう}→狩猟：13507_shuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Hunting is regulated by the Wildlife Protection Act.

examples.japanese: {鳥獣|ちょうじゅう}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{農作物|のうさくぶつ}→農作物：15271_nousakubutsu⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっており、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}められている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Damage to crops by wildlife has become a serious problem, and countermeasures are being implemented across the country.

notes:
Composed of {鳥|ちょう} (birds) and {獣|じゅう} (beasts). A literary and formal term that appears frequently in legal texts, environmental reports, and classical literature.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The famous {鳥獣戯画|ちょうじゅうぎが} (Scrolls of Frolicking Animals) is a set of picture scrolls from the 12th-13th centuries depicting animals behaving like humans. It is considered a precursor to modern manga and is a national treasure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鳥獣|ちょうじゅう}⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧: wildlife protection
- {鳥獣|ちょうじゅう}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: wildlife damage
- {鳥獣|ちょうじゅう}{戯画|ぎが}: Scrolls of Frolicking Animals (national treasure)
- {鳥獣|ちょうじゅう}⟦{保護区|ほごく}→保護区：04901_hogoku⟧: wildlife sanctuary
- ⟦{有害|ゆうがい}→有害：13002_yuugai⟧{鳥獣|ちょうじゅう}: harmful wildlife (pest species)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{野生動物|やせいどうぶつ}→野生動物：09251_yaseidoubutsu⟧: wild animals — more modern and conversational, includes all wild animals; {鳥獣|ちょうじゅう} is more formal and specifically means birds and mammals
- ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧: animals — general term covering all animals, not limited to wild ones
- ⟦{獣|けもの}→獣：23791_kemono⟧: beast; animal — a single wild animal, often with a nuance of ferocity
